attributes.name: Drowning Spikes Trap
attributes.powers: If undefeated, display this card next to your deck; you may not move or be moved while this barrier is next to your deck. While displayed, you may not move or be moved; at the start of each of your turns, succeed at a Dexterity, Acrobatics, or Strength 9 check to banish this card; at the end of each of your turns, bury the top card of your deck.
